name: Solano County Behavioral Health Provider Directory
description: Solano County Behavioral Health Plan's official provider directory, listing specialty mental health providers serving Medi-Cal members throughout the county.
fullDescription: Solano County Behavioral Health Plan's official provider directory, listing specialty mental health providers serving Medi-Cal members throughout the county.
whatTheyOffer:
- Mental health provider directory (PDF, English and Spanish)
- Member handbook in English, Spanish, and Tagalog
- Substance use providers are listed in Partnership HealthPlan's Medi-Cal directory for now (county directory adds them starting January 1, 2027)
- Access to services information
- Crisis resources
howToGetIt: View the directory online or call the Behavioral Health Access Line at 1-800-547-0495 (Monday-Friday, 8am-5pm) for mental health and co-occurring substance use services, or email BHAccess@SolanoCounty.gov.
keywords: Solano, Vallejo, Fairfield, mental health, substance use, provider directory, therapist, counselor, drug treatment, psychiatrist, clinic
